summary: Proves the parse time limit end to end. It plants a REAL hang by vi.mock-ing content-tokens.js so extractContentTokens spins forever on a marker string, sets COLDSTART_HOME to a temp dir (repair.jsonl would otherwise land in the real ~/.coldstart) and COLDSTART_PARSE_TIMEOUT_MS to 300. The recovery test stops a big TS file at 3..17ms limits (its wasm parse alone takes ~70ms, so the stop lands inside tree-sitter) and then requires real TS/JS/Python/Ruby parses to equal a baseline taken before; it fails if resetParsers is removed.

summary: Proves the parse time limit end to end. It plants a REAL hang by vi.mock-ing content-tokens.js so extractContentTokens spins forever on a marker string, and sets COLDSTART_HOME to a temp dir and COLDSTART_PARSE_TIMEOUT_MS to 300. Importing src/index.ts turns on V8's linear regex fallback in the vitest worker, so its regex case must use a backreference bomb (/^(a+)+\1$/) the linear engine cannot run, and that bomb is built with new RegExp from joined pieces because as a literal CodeQL js/redos flags it as a high-severity alert. The recovery test stops a big TS file at 3..17ms limits (its wasm parse alone takes ~70ms) and requires later TS/JS/Python/Ruby parses to equal a baseline; it fails if resetParsers is removed.
